mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, email, phone, status, created_at, updated_at FROM user ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET password = #{password}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (username, password, email, phone, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{status})
